formulas.name: Base Pool – 6 dice (count 6s)
formulas.description: Year Zero base/skill dice. Adjust the number for your pool size.

formulas.name: Stress Pool – 3 dice (count 6s, track 1s)
formulas.description: Roll stress (or gear) dice separately to track 1s for panic/breakage.

formulas.name: Push Base Pool – keep 1s and 6s, push once (1.7.0+)
formulas.description: Roll it, then use Push on the roll. Push keeps the 1s and 6s and rolls the other dice again, once. Needs app version 1.7.0 or later.

formulas.name: Push Stress Pool – keep 1s and 6s, push once (1.7.0+)
formulas.description: Stress (or gear) dice. Push keeps the 1s and 6s and rolls the other dice again, once. Counts 6s and tracks 1s. Needs app version 1.7.0 or later.
